# Scoped supplier results before constructor delegation

An owned generic constructor invokes an incoming Supplier<Map<K,V>> once,
retains the checked Map result and forwards two independent Function inputs to
its exact Map constructor. Both wrappers preserve the original three-argument
overload and subsequent actions. Four frozen constructor routes compare 96
cases twice, with source and SDK parent declarations; every original class,
method, field, Signature and role is checked after compiling all output.
Observers check dynamic result snapshots, null and invalid returns, callback
identity, partial writes, exact exceptions and later caller casts. Independent
wrong programs and Code-preserving Signature controls verify the observers.
Only authored fixtures execute.
